reason: An Android companion app for remotely viewing and controlling DeepSeek Harness sessions, including chat, planning, approvals, subagents, workflows, and completion notifications.

summaries.zh: 用于在安卓手机上通过局域网或中继连接、查看并控制 DeepSeek Harness 会话的移动端伴侣应用。
summaries.en: An Android companion app for connecting to, viewing, and controlling DeepSeek Harness sessions over a local network or relay.

capabilities: Connects to a DeepSeek Harness over a local network or relay
Displays and streams harness chat sessions
Sends prompts, slash commands, and skill requests to the harness
Reviews plans, goals, approvals, and user questions
Can interrupt subagents and manage background jobs and workflow runs
Discovers reachable hosts on the local network
Runs a foreground service for background notifications
Exports session logs and supports image attachments
